To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“The partial replacement of cement with coal BA is an effective way to improve the environmental and mechanical performance of cement mortars”.
the addition of bottom ash and fly ashes as a partial cement replacement in the manufacturing of mortars can improve the mechanical and environmental performance of mortars.
cement mortars with 10%, 25%, and 35% replacement of cement by coal bottom ash have similar environmental behaviour and better mechanical behaviour than mortar manufactured with fly ash.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a methodology that allows the evaluation of the environmental impact of cement mortars.
the development of a methodology to evaluate the environmental burden of mortars with coal bottom ash and/or fly ash as partial cement replacement.
a better understanding of the environmental behaviour of cementitious materials with partial replacement of cement with coal bottom ash (BA).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
BA could be an interesting alternative to FA as partial replacement in cement mortars.
the environmental behaviour of cementitious mortars with coal BA as partial cement replacement is better than that of mortars with coal FA.
the partial replacement of OPC by coal BA is as suitable as the partial replacement by FA, and even more suitable for some cement mortars.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mortars with 10% of BA and 25% of FA are the best option in terms of mechanical and environmental performance.
the use of BA in cement mortars is as suitable or even more suitable than the use of FA.
the environmental and mechanical behaviour of mortars manufactured with BA is better than the one of mortars manufactured only with OPC.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the environmental behaviour of mortars with partial cement replacement by BA is similar to that of the mortars with partial FA replacement, which is better than that of mortars with no partial replacement of cement.
coal BA can be used as partial cement replacement in cement mortars.

the environmental burden of the mortars with coal bottom ash (BA) is similar or better than the environmental burden of mortars manufactured with FA, and in the case of the compressive strength, they are better.
